mapper.update: UPDATE spectra_core.scheduler_job SET next_fire_at = #{nextFireAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND definition_status = 'REGISTERED'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM spectra_core.scheduler_job WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE spectra_core.scheduler_job SET desired_state = #{desiredState}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND definition_status = 'REGISTERED'

UPDATE spectra_core.scheduler_job SET definition_status = #{definitionStatus}, desired_state = #{desiredState}, next_fire_at = CASE WHEN #{definitionStatus} = 'REGISTERED' AND #{desiredState} = 'ENABLED' THEN next_fire_at ELSE NULL END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
